انحجبوا (form VII)
# اِنْحَجَبُوا (inḥajabū) /in.ħa.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
# اِنْحَجِبُوا (inḥajibū) /in.ħa.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْحَجَبَ (inḥajaba)
